description: JSON member names sort by UTF-16 code units, not code points, and the two genuinely differ here: U+FF3A is the lower code point but the higher UTF-16 first unit, so the astral key sorts first. A port that sorts member names by rune emits different bytes for search.json, whose tokens are member names drawn from arbitrary NFC text.
